judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`), acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/usageAggregation.acceptance.test.ts`), and adding two bullets to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, without actually implementing the production change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still assigns `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` instead of accumulating across rounds, the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately on `npm test`. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `afterModelResponse` signature parameter to `totalUsage`, did not remove the outdated under-counting bullet under `Measured semantics — out of scope` in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and did not add the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry. While the acceptance tests themselves accurately target the issue's multi-round and omitted-round scenarios, they were placed in a new file rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` as the reference did.
